title: Extra tax on earnings for super balances above $3 million (Division 296)
headline: An extra 15% tax on earnings linked to the part of a super balance above $3m, plus 10% more above $10m. First income year: 2026-27.
summary: Division 296 adds an individual-level tax on the share of super fund earnings that matches the part of a person's total super balance above $3 million, with a further 10% above $10 million. It taxes realised earnings only; the earlier plan to tax unrealised gains was dropped.

history.note: Redesign announced: $10m tier, indexation, realised earnings only

bigStat.caption: total super balance where the extra 15% starts

before: Fund earnings were taxed at 15% in accumulation and 0% in retirement phase, whatever the size of the balance.
after: An extra 15% on the share of earnings matching the part of your total super balance above $3 million.
A further 10% on the share above $10 million: 40% combined nominal rate on that share.
Realised earnings only; unrealised gains are not taxed. Both thresholds are indexed to CPI from 2027-28.
SMSFs can make a one-off, irrevocable election to reset asset cost bases to market value at 30 June 2026 for Division 296 purposes.
exemptions: Child recipients of income streams and structured settlement recipients.
Certain judicial and office-holder pensions. Defined benefit interests are deferred, not exempt.

workedExample.title: ATO example: Jordan
steps: Jordan's total super balance at 30 June 2027 is $4,000,000 and super earnings are $100,000.
Share above the $3m threshold: ($4m − $3m) ÷ $4m = 25%, so $25,000 of earnings is taxable under Division 296.

actions.text: Work out each member's total super balance across all funds at 30 June 2027 (LRBA amounts are excluded).
Decide whether to make the irrevocable CGT cost-base reset election for assets held at 30 June 2026; it needs market valuations and is due with the 2026-27 return.
If a member is in scope, plan for an actuary and for reporting relevant earnings in the 2026-27 SMSF annual return.
Plan cash flow: tax is due 84 days after an assessment, or you can elect to release money from super within 60 days.

positions.summary: Legislated the redesigned tax, noting the Liberals and Nationals opposed it.
Voted against the bill. Earlier repeal pledges applied to the lapsed unrealised-gains version; no 2026 pledge to repeal the final law was found.
Passed it unamended as a "downpayment" on wider tax reform.
